title: How to read the cutter counter
passage:
Internal work note | Seal Line 2

The cutter makes one piece per stroke. Its display counts every stroke, including the short trial run at the start of a shift. The total cannot be reset by operators. Record the displayed count before running any trial pieces.

The inspection tray holds only pieces rejected after the normal run begins. The tray is emptied at the start of each shift. Write its count beside the display count at the end of the shift. Keep trial pieces in the red bin, not in the inspection tray.

To work out how many good pieces a shift produced, subtract the opening display count from the closing count, then subtract that shift's trial pieces and its production rejects. Do not adjust a closing count on the display to make it match the report.

If the opening count was not recorded, leave the good-piece total blank. Send the closing count and the separate trial and inspection counts as usual. A supervisor must confirm the opening count before the good-piece total can be reported.
passageZh:
內部作業說明｜密封件第 2 產線

裁切機每次裁切會產出一件。顯示器會計入每次裁切，包括班初的短時間試做。操作人員無法將總計數歸零。裁切任何試做件之前，請記下顯示器的計數。

檢驗托盤只放正式生產開始後判定不合格的零件。每一班開始時要清空托盤。班末請把托盤件數記在顯示器計數旁。試做零件放進紅色箱，不要放在檢驗托盤。

計算當班合格零件數時，用班末顯示器計數減去班初計數，再減去當班試做件數和正式生產的不合格件數。不要為了讓顯示器的班末計數與報表相符而更改它。

如果沒有記下班初計數，合格件數欄請留白。班末計數、試做件數及檢驗托盤件數仍照常分別送出。合格件數須等主管確認班初計數後才能回報。
